#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    int maxOutside = 0, insideCount = 0, cur = 0;
    bool inside = false;

    for (size_t idx = 0; idx < s.length(); ++idx) {
        char ch = s[idx];
        if (ch == '(') {
            if (cur > maxOutside) maxOutside = cur;
            cur = 0;
            inside = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (cur > 0) {
                insideCount++;
                cur = 0;
            }
        } else if (ch == '_') {
            if (inside) {
                if (cur > 0) insideCount++;
            } else {
                if (cur > maxOutside) maxOutside = cur;
            }
            cur = 0;
        } else {
            cur++;
        }
    }
    if (cur > maxOutside) maxOutside = cur;
    cout << maxOutside << " " << insideCount << endl;
    return 0;
}
